tools.name: lookup_phone_number

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find a phone number in the Calmido directory (Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg). The query is a phone number, international (+31 20 123 4567) or national (020 123 4567); it is not a name or free text. Returns the matching directory entry, if any. Pass its id to `fetch` for the verdict and reports.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve who is behind a phone number from the Calmido directory: the community verdict, the number of reports, the most reported category and the registered business, with a link to the evidence. The id is the one `search` returned: the number in E.164 digits.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
